description: This file implements a hybrid expiration scheduler for burn-on-read messages in Mattermost, managing post expiration timing with setTimeout and polling, and handling visibility changes.

classes.name: BurnOnReadExpirationScheduler
classes.description: A class managing expiration timers for burn-on-read posts, using a hybrid approach of setTimeout and polling, with visibility API integration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the scheduler with Redux dispatch, attaching visibility change listener if not already initialized.

methods.name: registerPost
methods.description: Registers a post with expiration timestamps, scheduling expiration handling accordingly.

methods.name: unregisterPost
methods.description: Unregisters a post, removing it from tracking and rescheduling timers.

methods.name: recomputeSchedule
methods.description: Finds the next post to expire and sets up appropriate timers or polling based on delay.

methods.name: getNextExpiring
methods.description: Returns the post ID and expiration time of the soonest expiring post.

methods.name: checkAndExpirePosts
methods.description: Checks all tracked posts and expires those past their expiration plus grace period, dispatching expiration actions.

methods.name: handleVisibilityChange
methods.description: Handles tab visibility changes to trigger expiration checks when tab becomes visible.

methods.name: handleExpiration
methods.description: Handles immediate expiration of a specific post, removing it from tracking and dispatching expiration action.

methods.name: getActiveExpiration
methods.description: Determines which expiration timestamp (expireAt or maxExpireAt) occurs first.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up timers and event listeners, resetting the scheduler state.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns current active timers count and next expiration timestamp for debugging/testing.
